name: Local Plan Part 1: Strategic Policies and Sites

housing-numbers.notes: Required housing includes 590 homes per year (507 for Waverley's needs + 83 for Woking's unmet need). Allocated housing includes strategic sites plus Farnham NDP allocations. Committed housing includes completions 2013-2017 plus outstanding permissions and resolutions to permit. Windfall includes both 1-4 dwelling sites (468) and 5+ dwelling sites (494).
